scope: Forty design obligations for native provider/driver entry and witness boundary; distinct from test identities

scenarios.title: Actual H0 foundation
scenarios.required_observation: Adopt exact OS/host evidence and protected capabilities; no tool/session/PID/file-token substitution
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: No target self-qualification
scenarios.required_observation: H0 guards and observes G0 qualification; B1 depends only on accepted earlier capabilities
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Access isolation
scenarios.required_observation: Prove actual G0/S0 inability to mutate guard/stop/native capability or refuse
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Original binding
scenarios.required_observation: Host/session/process creation/ancestry/Job/clock native objects bind O; recycled identity refused
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Before first effect
scenarios.required_observation: Guard, capture, T0 and owned cleanup cover pre-Job/bootstrap/ambiguous-create failure
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Pinned ABI and build
scenarios.required_observation: Source/runtime/build/loaded dependency closure, exact native APIs; unsupported behavior refuses
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Handle allowlist
scenarios.required_observation: Exact real inheritable handles and Job association before candidate instruction; no implicit handles
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Independent resources
scenarios.required_observation: Original RAM/disk/process/Job/thread/device enforcement and startup/freshness maintained
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Stop and clock
scenarios.required_observation: Owned stop/heartbeat/time independent of candidate; original deadlines and immediate failure capture
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Host unavailability
scenarios.required_observation: Unavailable H0 methods/refusal path cause REFUSED_UNADMITTED without candidate effects
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Exact frame
scenarios.required_observation: 96-byte request /80-byte response, complete expected O/nonce/payload digest, fixed numeric tags
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Malformed request
scenarios.required_observation: Short/long/bad magic/version/opcode/scenario/length/flags/reserved rejects with exact prefix
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Single invocation
scenarios.required_observation: One entry, reentry/second request and late postrevocation arrival retained in original domains
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Finite native effects
scenarios.required_observation: Complete normal/error/loader/formatter/type domains; no arbitrary callback/path/code
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Partial write/read
scenarios.required_observation: Every actual byte/read offset/order retained; exact framing distinct from EOF
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Overlapped lifecycle
scenarios.required_observation: Each pending op owns distinct state/event/buffer until actual completion
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Cancellation races
scenarios.required_observation: Normal/cancel/error after request handled; ERROR_NOT_FOUND not closure proof
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: First fault and secondary failure
scenarios.required_observation: Monotone refusal latch; refusal-helper or publisher failure preserves original prefix
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Deadline and resource stop
scenarios.required_observation: Every partial state owned; no reset/resume/automatic retry after possible effect
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Scoped result
scenarios.required_observation: Expected negative qualifies only exact observed claim with complete original capture/guards/closure
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Resource codec
scenarios.required_observation: Exact80-byte offsets, first-failed-call and missing-vs-zero status, QPC/overflow/reserved checks
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Capture codec
scenarios.required_observation: Exact64-byte offsets, original role/channel/ordinal/invocation/range/order; no model-counter substitution
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Canonical base64
scenarios.required_observation: Padding/unused bits/length/re-encoding checks; preserve raw bytes without authority claim
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Valid projection width
scenarios.required_observation: B688/I684/C833 fieldwise maxima; input8192 caps unchanged, malformed input outside tighter bound
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Full stream population
scenarios.required_observation: S128/128,G256/128 source proof includes every failure; no status-loop or dropped chunk
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Full host transport
scenarios.required_observation: Complete8192-byte/64-chunk tool and4096 external source grammars incl framing/error/cancel
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Role packing
scenarios.required_observation: Every row, syntax layer, wrapper/confirmation/remainder fits exact role without transfer or extra reports
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Resource schedule
scenarios.required_observation: 100ms periodic plus all enumerated startup/transitions, no catchup/omission; suffix25 within90
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Original witness retention
scenarios.required_observation: Authored encoding/pin never replaces native capture source and independently retained object
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Overflow and allocation
scenarios.required_observation: Unexpected oversize consumes/refuses with prefix; all live buffers, peak/process/Job cost bounded
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Exact entry admission
scenarios.required_observation: Unused O/distinct M, NOMINAL_ECHO-only membership; no Q/S/test-child batch implied
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Build/preparation costs
scenarios.required_observation: Separately guarded source-reviewed build artifacts; no outside-clock free compile/load/hash/copy
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Whole budget
scenarios.required_observation: F/M and all stage/failure/cleanup worst cases fit original90/60/65/etc; unknown refuses
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: O closure
scenarios.required_observation: External G0/S0 exit/EOF/Job/input/response observation; process cannot prove own future return
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: M publication
scenarios.required_observation: Exactly16 roles/33 reservations, once-only claims, full failed/temp write census and original guard
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Independent review
scenarios.required_observation: Authenticated complete review/confirmation within encoded caps, clock and original provenance
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Distinct O/M
scenarios.required_observation: Original O return preserved; later M closure not appended as O or substituted by O evidence
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Final last-writer witness
scenarios.required_observation: Actual H0 finalize_metadata route independently retained after last charged write within existing roles and clock; otherwise incomplete
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Incomplete evidence
scenarios.required_observation: Unknown custody, hidden cleanup, lost transport/final witness never promoted to scoped complete negative
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection

scenarios.title: Debt preservation
scenarios.required_observation: 1125/51,Q360/S140,765 exact held rows and all predecessor scenarios/117/V34/science unchanged
scenarios.membership: Design obligation, not an admitted E1 batch or cohort selection
